name: Discord authoritative RAG admin UX and corpus health
implemented: Added deterministic Discord corpus health classification for questions, answers, content queue rows, and content drafts.
Added the Authoritative RAG corpus health panel to /admin/discord.
Added the RAG knowledge approval desk to /admin/discord.
Added admin actions that move Discord rows into Phase 5 approved states: questions -> closed, answers -> helpful, content queue -> published.
Reused existing draft approval action for content drafts, preserving the quality/policy gate.
Added Playwright E2E proof from dashboard approval to rag_sources/rag_documents.

verifiedCommands.result: 65 sources upserted after temporary E2E proof cleanup; no approved live Discord rows remained.

flow: Verify the row appears in the RAG knowledge approval desk as blocked.
Verify the source row status becomes published.
Verify rag_sources contains discord_content_queue:<id> with approved_for_rag=true.
Reload dashboard and verify the row shows synced.
Clean up temporary source, document cascade, queue row, and events.

honestNotes: The current real production Discord corpus still has no approved live knowledge rows after cleanup.
The E2E proves the complete mechanism with a temporary row, then removes that row so production data is not polluted.
A direct Playwright JSON reporter run failed because it bypassed the env-loading wrapper; the authoritative E2E proof used npm run test:e2e:local with .env.local loaded and passed.
whatIsLeft: Phase 7 should add a one-click admin sync action or job trigger so admins do not need to wait for cron/CLI after approving knowledge.
Add corpus drilldown filters for source kind, state, author, and channel once the real Discord corpus has more rows.
Add alerts when approved/stale rows remain unsynced beyond the SLA.
